features.title: Health-aware selected-pool failover (IMP-019)
features.description: Deterministic 1-failover walker over the ranked user-selected pool, gated by a transport/availability whitelist. pickFailover(registry, role, requirements, attemptedIds, failure) consumes rankUserSelectedForRole (F-184), skips any ID in attemptedIds, and returns the next eligible ranked ID plus a FailoverVerdict audit trail (primary, failover, attempts, exhaustReason, chain).
